description: See every worktree your parallel agents work in, review what each one changed, and send your comments back to the agent that made the change. A full-screen Vantage page lists every recent thread's worktrees in bb's sidebar, grouped by what needs doing in plain words (Waiting on you, Ready to review, Still working, Done), and opens the worktree that needs you first, showing its changes as a stream of diffs with a file tree, side-by-side view and expandable context, plus an overlaps page for files two worktrees both changed and an All changes view by repository. Vantage counts only what a thread did: it compares each worktree with the closest base branch, leaves out branch history its threads did not write, and folds clones and big untracked folders into one uncounted entry. Inside a thread, a Vantage tab opens on a strip of its worktrees, a Worktrees section sits in bb's thread context card (or a small segment above the composer when there is no card), and an Info section and an optional sidebar line show the counts. Every thread shows its real state and every file has a Reviewed tick, with nothing to turn on.
